QuestInfo.name: New World Map Function
QuestInfo.0: Maple Admin wants to talk to you.
QuestInfo.1: Maple Admin wants you to try the new World Map function.  The new search function allows you to search for NPCs, monsters, and locations all at once. The new search function also allows you to search for monsters around your level so that you can easily find them. Press W to open the World Map.
QuestInfo.2: Use the new World Map function.

0.0: Hello, #h0#. Did you know that the World Map of Maple World has changed? Wait, don't tell me that you don't even know how to view the World Map! Try opening the World Map by pressing the W key.
0.1: The World Map lets you to view all of Maple World, and you can also find out which map a monster or NPC is located at. Not only that, but you can see where you, #h0#, are, where your party members are, where your guild members are, and where your wife or husband is.
0.2: There are also two new features! Try using the search feature in the World Map. You'll be able to find NPCs, monsters, and maps more easily. You can also find monsters that are suitable for your level by using the Recommended Monsters button.
0.3: Did you understand everything? Try opening the World Map right now by pressing W and trying out all of the new features!

no.0: It seems like you still don't understand how to use the World Map features! I'll explain it to you again, so listen carefully.
